name: riverfront
description: Riverfront: batalha por turnos em 3D, no espírito do Batalha Naval.
author: Gustavo Kamchen <gkamchen@gmail.com>

scripts.build: node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs && npm run build -w @riverfront/core && npm run build -w @riverfront/ai && npm run build -w @riverfront/protocol && npm run build -w @riverfront/client && npm run build -w @riverfront/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @riverfront/core && npm run test -w @riverfront/ai && npm run test -w @riverfront/client && npm run test -w @riverfront/protocol && npm run test -w @riverfront/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @riverfront/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @riverfront/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:win -w @riverfront/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:mac -w @riverfront/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:linux -w @riverfront/desktop
